gatecal_engine.py (gatecal adapter).note: 2026-11-21 A2 fix: the planted-edge drift is now rebuilt per trade (_apply_drift) so it COMPOUNDS through the equity chain. The old inline adjustment derived eqb from the ORIGINAL chain, so every trade's drift was lost at each step and only the LAST trade's ~delta reached ret_pct -- G5 measured an effectively un-drifted book while the pnl-based gates saw the edge. The original calibration artifact bdb602a549eeecbe (sha 7e193db6) verifies REFUSED by design. New calibration 1d938af1df8dbfc0: G5 monotone in the planted edge (n300: 0.0150/0.0375/0.0925/0.4875 at 0/5/10/20 bps), v1 conjunction at n300 d20 = 0.3100 (old 0.0175, ~18x); G1/G3/G6 unchanged (within trial noise); v2 rates bit-identical to the old report (v2 never read the equity chain) -- v2's 9.5% joint power at +20bps/n300 is genuine. gate2.py and _gates_v2.py also changed in this campaign (N4/N3); their bytes are part of the gatecal concat, which is why the whole generation moved.
